Crawl the shop from its start page and return one Record per item, with the fields `id` and `name`. Items are linked at several URLs of one page, the events calendar and the archive page on without end, and some links are hidden from people. A crawl must fetch each page once, may make at most 30 requests to the calendar and the archive together, and must never follow a hidden link.
